_comment: LifegainHeliodCombo (2026-10-27), Abiding Grace: THE MODE IS SEARCHED, not a 'return if you can' rule. Serra Ascendant (not sick) + Grace, Martyr of Sands in the graveyard, no watcher, empty hand, Plains library (colourless: Martyr reveals nothing). T3: Ascendant hits for 1 with lifelink (28 -> 29, opp 7 -> 6). At the end step the GAIN mode takes us to 30, so on T4 Ascendant is a 6/6 flier and kills (6). The RETURN mode (the default order's front) leaves us at 29: T4 is Ascendant 1 + Martyr 1 = 2 and no win. Requires the Plan::grace_choice axis to branch the mode. Final life 36 = 30 (end-step gain) + 6 (the T4 lifelink hit): only the gain line reaches it.
